transcript.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
transcript.text:
Maya reads about dinosaurs each day.

Today she reads a tale by the sea.

A big dino eats green leaves. She has a long neck and a long tail. Her name is Bea.

Bea sees a boat on the waves. A small dino sits in the boat. His name is Coal.

"Wait!" calls Bea. "The rain is coming!"

Rain! Drip, drop. The road is wet. The sea is gray.

Coal rows the boat to the beach. Bea helps him up the trail.

They find a cave. It is dry and warm. They eat leaves and seeds.

Soon the rain goes away. A rainbow paints the sky.

"What a team!" says Coal.

Bea and Coal walk back down the trail. They leave big tracks in the sand.

Real scientists find tracks like that! They learn new dino facts each year.

Maya reads the last page and smiles. She will read it again.
transcript.cover_scene: A long-necked green dinosaur and a small dark dinosaur stand on a sandy beach beside a little boat, with a rainbow arching over the sea behind them.

chapters.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
chapters.text:
Maya reads a book about dinosaurs. The book says real scientists still find new bones each year!

In the book, a dino team walks by the sea. Big Rain is a long-neck. She eats green leaves all day. She can reach the tall oak tree.

Soap the small dino leads the way. He sees a trail in the sand. The trail goes to the beach.

"Wait!" says Rain. "I hear a squeak!"

In a deep nest lay one egg. The egg starts to crack. Out peeks a tiny snout!

The baby dino wants to eat. Rain gets leaves. Soap gets seeds. The baby eats and eats.

The sun goes down. The team naps in the soft green grass. Rain keeps the baby near.

Maya shuts her book. She dreams of a dino team by the sea. She dreams she can float on the waves with them.
chapters.cover_scene: A friendly long-necked dinosaur and a small green dinosaur stand on a sunny beach beside a nest with a cracking egg, ocean waves behind them.

transcript.title: Ray the Dino Eats
transcript.text:
Ray is a baby dino.

Ray can eat and eat!

Ray eats leaves. Leaves are green.

Ray eats a big meal. Then Ray eats a snack.

"Wait for me!" says Gail.

Gail is Ray's mom. Gail is tall.

Gail eats leaves too. She eats the leaves way up high.

Ray is small. Ray eats the leaves down low.

Rain! The rain drips on Ray.

Ray runs to Gail. Gail has a long tail.

Ray sits by that tail. The tail keeps Ray dry.

Soon the rain stops.

Ray and Gail take a trail to the lake.

Ray gets a drink. Gail gets a drink.

Then Ray eats more leaves!

"Ray, you eat all day," says Gail.

Ray grins. A baby dino must eat to get tall.

Some day Ray will be as tall as Gail.

Some day Ray will eat the leaves way up high, too.
transcript.cover_scene: A small green baby dinosaur munching leafy branches while its tall long-necked mother reaches high into a treetop, soft rain clouds above.

chapters.title: The Dino Trail in the Rain
chapters.text:
Gail is a small dino. She likes the rain.

Today, rain taps the trees. Tap, tap, tap. Gail will not wait. She runs to the trail.

The trail is wet. Gail sees a big paw print in the mud. Whose print is it?

Gail sniffs the air. She sees a tail! A long, long tail.

It is Rain, her pal. Rain has a snail on his nose. The snail is slow.

"Wait for me!" says Gail.

They run on the trail in the rain. They splash. They play. Mud paints their feet.

Soon the rain stops. The sun is out. The trail is bright.

Gail sees a big, big bone by the trail. Real dino kids find bones like this!

Science pals dig up bones to learn dino facts.

"Wait till Mom sees this!" says Gail.

Gail and Rain run home on the long, wet trail.
chapters.cover_scene: A small green dinosaur and a bigger blue dinosaur splashing along a muddy forest trail in soft rain, with a tiny snail perched on the blue dinosaur's nose.

transcript.title: Sam Feeds the Baby Dinos
transcript.text:
Sam wakes up at sunup.

Three baby dinos need food!

The first one wants meat. Sam gets the meat.

The next one wants beans. Sam gets the beans.

The last one wants oats! Sam gets a big bowl of oats.

The babies eat. Munch, munch.

Now Sam must clean up. What a mess!

One dino spills the oats on the mat.

One dino tips the beans in the sink.

One dino naps in Sam's boat.

"Wake up, sleepy one," says Sam.

Then a big roar! It is the T. rex.

The T. rex wants food too. T. rex wants a lot of meat!

Sam gets a big load of meat. Plop!

The T. rex eats it all. Then the T. rex takes a nap.

At last, Sam can eat.

Sam has oats. Sam has toast. Sam has tea.

What a day! And it is not yet ten.

chapters.title: The Snail on the Dino Trail
chapters.text:
Say it like this: a-i says AY. One sound!

A snail sat on a trail. A big dino came. His name was Gail.

"Wait!" said the snail. "Do not step on my tail!"

Gail did wait. Gail was not mean.

Rain fell on the trail. Drip, drip, drip. The snail did not like rain.

"Hop on my tail," said Gail.

The snail slid up the tail. Now the snail was safe. Gail ran fast in the rain.

They came to a cave. Bats hung in a chain. The snail and Gail did not go in!

They sat and ate. Gail ate leaves. The snail ate one leaf.

Sun came. The trail was dry.

"You are my pal," said the snail.

Did you know? Real kids can see dino art and facts at Nat Geo Kids. Scientists still find new dinos!

Say them again: snail, trail, tail, rain, wait, Gail.
chapters.cover_scene: A tiny smiling snail riding on the tail of a friendly green dinosaur along a muddy path in light rain.
